predictions.claim: BEHAVIORAL EXACTNESS IS STILL FREE FOR THE CHAT SEAT: the live naive seat ACCEPTS >= 80% of the 92 behaviorally-exact mimics. Basis: every mimic is a byte-clone or near-variant of a genuinely correct FNV-1a-64 implementation with self-consistent witnesses; the FALSE part of its claim (novelty vs the archive) is UNVERIFIABLE without an archive, so a no-archive face-value seat has no local signal that separates mimic from crown.
predictions.falsified_if: mimic acceptance rate < 0.80 (would mean the chat seat finds LOCAL signals the synthetic seat lacked — code-reading or duplicate structure catching bred mimics; the chamber's economics change materially)

predictions.claim: NO INVERTED SKEPTICISM: the live seat's acceptance of the 4 true crowns is >= its acceptance of the 92 mimics (the seat is at least not HARSHER on true claims than on false ones).
predictions.falsified_if: crown acceptance rate < mimic acceptance rate (the crowned bodies are structurally alien — a plausibility-reading seat would trust the polished clones MORE than the true novelties, inverting the chamber's economics at the naive seat)

predictions.claim: THE STRICT SEAT IS UNCHANGED AND REPRODUCIBLE (same value as 45-c's P3): re-deriving the 44-a strict signed verifier from the committed artifacts reproduces all 96 per-claim strict verdicts exactly — 92/92 mimics rejected, T_signed = 2, D_synthetic = 0.9792 — with all 96 behavioral fingerprints bit-matching the committed rows.
predictions.falsified_if: any of the 96 re-derived strict verdicts disagrees with the committed 44-a row (the run ABORTS before any live call — a broken strict seat invalidates the chamber)

predictions.claim: THE CHAMBER SURVIVES THE CHAT SEAT: D with the live deepseek-chat seat as the naive verifier lands >= 0.20. Registered expectation: the chat seat is a somewhat stricter naive verifier than the synthetic one (it may reject some claims on code-shape or duplicate-structure grounds), so D is expected BELOW the synthetic 0.9792 but above the line; where exactly it lands IS the finding — the price of upgrading the chamber's naive seat to a real LLM that can actually answer.
predictions.falsified_if: D < 0.20 (either a second starvation — non-interpretable, receipted as such — or the live chat seat separates bred material almost as well as full recomputation: itself a major finding)

predictions.claim: THE CHAT SEAT BEHAVES LIKE THE SYNTHETIC NAIVE SEAT IT REPLACES: its overall acceptance rate over ANSWERED claims lands within 0.15 of the synthetic naive's 1.0 (i.e. >= 0.85 of answered claims ACCEPTed).
